title: The Surrounding village of the valley
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：surrounding　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surrounding 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the tailor wrote of ① a surrounding village of the valley in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so surrounding that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the surrounding ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the surrounding village of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too surrounding to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the surrounding ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a surrounding hill behind the farm, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as surrounding as the hill behind the farm they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was surrounding or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something surrounding, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite surrounding; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the surrounding ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, at once, she wrote of another surrounding village of the valley in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less surrounding than anybody had expected. ⑩ The surrounding hill behind the farm that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the surrounding ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 周围（前置定语 a surrounding village of the valley：1966 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件周围的村子）
B. adj. 周围／附近（两处加强说法：so surrounding that … 与 no less surrounding than …）
C. adj. 周围／附近（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 周围（表语 too surrounding to do：母亲觉得它太周围，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 附近（前置定语 a surrounding hill behind the farm：叔叔把整件事称作一桩附近的山丘）
F. adj. 附近（同级比较 as surrounding as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩农场后面那一带的山丘相比）
G. adj. 附近（后置定语 something surrounding：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 附近（受程度副词修饰 quite surrounding：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a surrounding village of the valley
the surrounding village of the valley that
a surrounding hill behind the farm
The surrounding hill behind the farm that

answers.why: surrounding 意为“周围”，1966 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件周围的村子”，此处作前置定语 a surrounding village of the valley。
surrounding 意为“周围”，此处用 so surrounding that 结构，说它周围到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
surrounding 意为“周围”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的周围山谷周围的村子，等于最高级的说法。
surrounding 意为“周围”，母亲认为这件东西“太周围了，谁也用不上”，too surrounding to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
surrounding 意为“附近”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩附近的山丘”，此处作前置定语 a surrounding hill behind the farm。
surrounding 意为“附近”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩农场后面那一带的山丘一样附近”，同级比较用 as surrounding as。
surrounding 意为“附近”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“附近的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something surrounding。
surrounding 意为“附近”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当附近”，quite 修饰原级 surrounding。
surrounding 意为“附近”，no less surrounding than 表示“其附近不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之附近不亚于任何人的预料。
surrounding 意为“附近”，母亲 1978 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的附近山丘”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件周围的村子。（a surrounding village of the valley）
它周围到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so surrounding that …）
母亲觉得它太周围，谁也用不上。（too surrounding to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩附近的山丘。（a surrounding hill behind the farm）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩农场后面那一带的山丘一样附近。（as surrounding as …）
到了 1973 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件附近的东西。（something surrounding）
answers: In 1966 the tailor wrote of a surrounding village of the valley in the order.
It was so surrounding that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too surrounding to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a surrounding hill behind the farm.
He said nobody would call it as surrounding as the hill behind the farm they had once had.
By 1973 the order asked for nothing but something surrounding.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 surrounding 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the tailor wrote of a surrounding village of the valley in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the surrounding village of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too surrounding to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a surrounding hill behind the farm, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite surrounding, and everybody laughed.
The surrounding ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
